data.content: With all our excitement and festiv spirit, we helped organize the 'Summer Fest' edition.
The special feature of this edition was its anniversary.

To capture the radiant era of its 17th anniversary, we came up with the concept of an event called 'SI7VER PARTY!' The term 'silver' not only represents the word 'argent' but also incorporates the jubilant number I7 in a stylized form as SI7VER.
Throughout this time, we worked on designing all the posters, banners, and accompanying materials.
Duplex is one of the most popular night clubs in Kosovë, founded in 2007, which since its opening became an icon of night life.
This club offers a variety of events throughout the week, from DJ nights and famous artists to themed events.
Karrota organized Duplex's events for various parties taking care of every detail, from the text of the parties, their design to the reception of the guests.
We gave each event a certain theme and worked based on it.
One of the events that caused a great stir and aroused curiosity throughout the country was "Black Helmet". The whole town became curious as to who was behind the black helmet.
We wrote an article for the newspaper about this event, which was quickly distributed throughout the internet, and there were many comments

Karrota also manages the social network for this club. We created a new spirit for social media in addition to promoting the music night and the performing artists, the posts also have memes and various content.
